description_en: Queries a list of report tracking tasks. This operation returns all tracking tasks under your account
description_zh: 调用DescribeCdnDeliverList查询报表订阅任务列表，系统将返回该用户所有的订阅任务列表
name: DescribeCdnDeliverList

parameters.description_en: The ID of the tracking task to query. If you do not specify this parameter, all tracking tasks are returned.
parameters.description_zh: 待查询的订阅任务ID。如果不传该参数，默认返回所有的订阅任务。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the tracking task to query. If you do not specify this parameter, all tracking tasks are returned
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的订阅任务ID。如果不传该参数，默认返回所有的订阅任务
parameters.name: deliver_id
